source_name: NLB Group — Press Releases (group newsroom, Ljubljana)
why_relevant: NLB d.d. Ljubljana is the parent of NLB Banka AD Skopje, a systemic MK bank. Group press releases announce subsidiary CEO/management board appointments, mergers and reorganisations, typically ahead of MK-language coverage.

source_name: NLB Group — Investor News / inside information (regulatory disclosures)
why_relevant: NLB is LJSE/LSE-listed; inside-information notices carry board nominations, subsidiary M&A (e.g. Addiko takeover offer) and group reorganisations that cascade to the MK subsidiary's structure and headcount.

source_name: NLB d.d. — Management and Supervisory Board pages (SI)
why_relevant: Roster page revealing where MK country executives move to/from within the group (e.g. Antonio Argir's move from NLB Banka Skopje to the Ljubljana HQ); useful as a change-detection target.

Direct majority owner of Sparkasse Bank Makedonija AD Skopje. Its Graz press releases carried the Ohridska Banka acquisition (2019) and the Ohridska–Sparkasse merger (2021) — the canonical upstream record of MK subsidiary reorganisation and consequent role/headcount changes.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG — Press releases / ad-hoc
why_relevant: Ultimate group above Steiermärkische; ad-hoc and press announcements cover savings-bank-sector reorganisations and CEE country-market restructurings that determine the MK unit's mandate.

source_name: Sparkasse Bank Makedonija AD Skopje — corporate site / news (MK)
why_relevant: Local publication point for parent-driven board appointments (historically Gligor Bishev as CEO, Alvin Alicevic, Nina Nedanoska) and post-merger organisational structure.

source_name: Türkiye Halk Bankası A.Ş. — Özel Durum Açıklamaları (investor disclosures)
why_relevant: Parent of Halkbank AD Skopje (which absorbed Ziraat Bank AD Skopje). Material disclosures on subsidiary capital, mergers and senior appointments appear here in Turkish before any MK coverage.

source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu, Türkiye Halk Bankası issuer page
why_relevant: Turkey's statutory disclosure platform — the authoritative, machine-friendly upstream feed for Halkbank notices including subsidiary/participation changes affecting Halkbank AD Skopje.

Local landing point for parent-decided general-manager changes (e.g. Bilal Sucubaşı's 8-year tenure ending on transfer to Türkiye Halk Katılım) and board composition after the Ziraat Skopje absorption.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — Ad-hoc News (inside information)
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent of ProCredit Bank AD Skopje. Ad-hoc notices carry group Management Board changes (e.g. chair transition to Eriola Bibolli effective 01.03.2026) — and PCH board members sit on the Skopje supervisory board, so group changes propagate directly to MK governance.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Annual Reports & Disclosure Reports (PDF series)
why_relevant: Annual/Disclosure reports enumerate supervisory-board seats at ProCredit Bank A.D. Skopje and record dated management-board changes; the richest structured record of MK-relevant governance and staffing across years.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Voting Rights & Managers' Transactions notifications
why_relevant: Tracks shifts among core shareholders (EBRD, IFC, KfW/DOEN) that historically precede governance and country-strategy changes reaching the Skopje bank.

source_name: EBRD — News & project summary documents (North Macedonia / ProCredit shareholding)
why_relevant: EBRD is a core shareholder of ProCredit Holding (raised to 8.7%, partly buying IFC's stake) and finances MK banks incl. Sparkasse Bank Macedonia; its news and Project Summary Documents disclose equity stakes and board-nomination rights that shape MK bank governance.

source_name: EBRD — Nominee Directors / Board Practice guidance
why_relevant: Explains how EBRD appoints nominee directors to investee banks — the mechanism by which an IFI shareholding converts into a board seat at an MK bank; needed to interpret board-composition changes correctly.

source_name: Central Cooperative Bank AD Sofia (Chimimport group) — corporate/IR site
why_relevant: Bulgarian parent holding ~87.35% of Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје (formerly Silex Bank, renamed 22.10.2008). Parent disclosures via Chimimport/BSE-Sofia are the upstream record for MK subsidiary board and strategy changes.

source_name: Silk Road Bank AD Skopje — corporate site (owner: Silk Road Capital AG, Switzerland)
why_relevant: Foreign-owned MK bank (ex-Alpha Bank AD Skopje, sold 2016 to Swiss Silk Road Capital AG). Owner is unlisted, so the bank's own site plus NBRM/securities-commission notices are the only channel for owner-driven management and capital changes.

source_name: MarketScreener / TheOfficialBoard / TheOrg — commercial board & org-chart aggregators
why_relevant: Aggregate board/manager rosters for MK subsidiaries (NLB Banka AD Skopje, Sparkasse Bank Macedonia, Halkbank AD Skopje incl. executive director Turhan Ademi) — cheap change-detection, but must be corroborated against the parent or NBRM.

source_name: LinkedIn — MK bank executive profiles and parent-group moves
why_relevant: Individual profiles (e.g. Halkbank AD Skopje executives) often show a parent-group transfer weeks before any press release; also the primary channel for MK bank hiring signals.
